rationale: Shared input-only fixture: 24 adversarial argument values and defined expansion variables exercise real Windows cmd behavior and the pure parser. It supplies no parser results, quoting logic or admission decisions. Retain all entries; no standalone runnable cases.

Input-only real npm/pnpm shim bodies plus builders for targets under temporary directories. Concrete interpreter branches, extensionless targets and NODE_PATH content match actual producers; no resolver algorithm or expected decisions are implemented. Retain as fixtures with no standalone cases.

Retain real renderer, snapshot and action orchestration against fake AT-SPI boundaries. Remove four exact nonzero tree-walk counts; retain zero-enumeration controls and all semantic/geometry output assertions.

cases.title: test_snapshot_keeps_semantics_and_image_when_child_geometry_stalls
cases.reason: Fake-clock semantic and geometry stalls exercise make_snapshot, preserving actions, stable indices, screenshot bounds and timeout restoration.

cases.title: test_nonstandard_window_selection_and_fresh_restored_capture
cases.reason: Application, pid and title queries with a nonstandard window position observe the selected window and fresh post-restore coordinates.

cases.title: test_window_only_protection_preserves_completed_semantic_action
cases.reason: A successful semantic click remains successful when later geometry stalls; actual protected-window selection still blocks another action.

cases.title: test_compacted_browser_records_keep_their_own_frames
cases.reason: Browser compaction preserves each surviving record's own geometry rather than borrowing an omitted tab's frame.

cases.title: test_geometry_skips_insufficient_budget_and_restores_action_timeout
cases.reason: A nearly exhausted geometry budget skips a read; a failing read temporarily bounds its timeout and restores the normal action timeout.

cases.title: test_named_non_generic_node_skips_unused_summary_walk
cases.reason: A labelled leaf renders without traversing unused children; zero reads protects the remote-accessibility performance boundary.

cases.title: test_wide_labeled_controls_never_enumerate_suppressed_children
cases.reason: The role table renders wide labelled controls without enumerating their 10,000 suppressed children.

cases.title: test_control_value_or_identifier_keeps_suppression
cases.reason: Value-only and identifier-only controls still suppress children rather than requiring a name.

cases.title: test_unlabeled_controls_keep_child_indices_and_depth
cases.reason: Unlabelled controls preserve nested runtime paths and output depth. Remove the exact nonzero traversal-call count, which reflects implementation order.

cases.title: test_suppressed_child_failure_keeps_control_output
cases.reason: A labelled control whose child enumeration would throw never enumerates suppressed children and still renders.

cases.title: test_named_generic_node_skips_unused_summary_walk
cases.reason: A named generic container retains its children and avoids an added text summary. Remove the exact nonzero read count and describe observed output in the title.

cases.title: test_unnamed_generic_node_keeps_plain_text_summary
cases.reason: An unnamed plain-text container produces one compact summary. Remove the exact nonzero traversal-call count while preserving summary and record assertions.

cases.title: test_row_keeps_its_specific_summary_walk
cases.reason: A row retains its label, child records and specific text summary. Remove the exact nonzero traversal-call count without weakening output assertions.

cases.title: test_empty_generic_wrapper_keeps_elision_path_and_depth
cases.reason: Eliding an empty generic wrapper preserves the child's original runtime path and output indentation.

cases.title: test_child_failure_keeps_fail_soft_row_output
cases.reason: A defunct child enumeration fails softly while retaining its parent row without a false truncation flag.

cases.title: test_node_limit_keeps_exact_prefix_and_truncation
cases.reason: The node budget retains the exact record prefix and marks node truncation without incorrectly reporting depth truncation.

cases.title: test_depth_limit_keeps_exact_prefix_and_flag
cases.reason: The depth budget retains the last allowed record and marks depth truncation separately.

rationale: Eight standalone rendering scenarios plus a real handshake, manually enumerated because there are no Pester It declarations. Fixtures model UIA input; production constructs the records, summaries and truncation state. No Windows changes or native input execution.

cases.title: runtime handshake
cases.reason: The real runtime is dot-sourced with a handshake operation before invoking its renderer, without issuing native input.

cases.title: named control
cases.reason: Named controls suppress child records and preserve the rendered label; UIA enumeration counts also detect added summary work.

cases.title: named generic container
cases.reason: Named generic containers keep their actual child records and indentation rather than collapsing into an anonymous summary.

cases.title: anonymous generic summary
cases.reason: Unnamed plain-text groups compact multiple child strings into one semantic summary.

cases.title: row summary
cases.reason: Row-specific summaries preserve the row label and child records.

cases.title: elided wrapper
cases.reason: An empty generic wrapper is elided without increasing the visible child depth.

cases.title: failed child enumeration
cases.reason: A failing UIA child query retains the parent record and line rather than throwing away the snapshot.

cases.title: node limit
cases.reason: A lowered node budget retains the expected prefix and reports node truncation separately from depth truncation.

cases.title: depth limit
cases.reason: A lowered depth budget retains the last allowed record and reports the depth flag; limits are restored in finally.

rationale: Retain real binary/wire integration rather than replacing it with mocked publication receipts. The compositor and private X display isolate tests from the user clipboard; native transfer timing is exercised across real pipes.

cases.title: test_both_protocols_preserve_bytes_and_serve_repeated_pastes
cases.reason: Both real wire protocols publish and repeatedly serve the exact large Unicode/CRLF input; cancellation closes the owner connection.

cases.title: test_unsupported_protocol_never_publishes_or_creates_a_popup
cases.reason: A compositor exposing neither data-control protocol returns unsupported with DISPLAY disabled and never publishes or echoes private text.

cases.title: test_missing_display_rejects_without_echoing_text
cases.reason: A missing isolated display returns unavailable without echoing private clipboard input.

cases.title: test_size_limit_precedes_selection_publication
cases.reason: Input above 16 MiB is rejected before publishing a source.

cases.title: test_probe_does_not_write
cases.reason: Probe detects protocol support without publishing any clipboard source.

cases.title: test_replacement_during_ack_is_success_but_device_loss_is_failure
cases.reason: Immediate cancellation is successful replacement, while device finish and seat removal are publication failures before acknowledgement.

cases.title: test_owner_startup_failure_reaches_the_parent
cases.reason: An injected child fork failure reaches the real parent acknowledgement path rather than reporting publication success.

cases.title: test_slow_progressing_paste_is_not_truncated
cases.reason: A real slow pipe reader continues making progress for longer than the idle timeout and must receive all bytes.

cases.title: test_stalled_receiver_does_not_block_cancellation
cases.reason: A stalled pipe receiver cannot prevent the owner from processing cancellation.

cases.title: test_incoming_clipboard_and_primary_offers_are_released
cases.reason: Incoming clipboard and primary-selection offers are destroyed without replacing or breaking the published copy.

cases.title: test_device_finished_and_seat_removal_stop_the_owner
cases.reason: Post-acknowledgement device finish and seat removal stop the detached owner.

cases.title: test_stalled_transfers_are_bounded_and_expire
cases.reason: The ninth concurrent stalled transfer is refused, earlier stalled transfers expire, and capacity is recovered for a subsequent complete paste.

rationale: Retain real binary/wire integration rather than replacing it with mocked publication receipts. The compositor and private X display isolate tests from the user clipboard; native transfer timing is exercised across real pipes.

cases.title: test_preserves_empty_unicode_crlf_and_large_incremental_transfers
cases.reason: A private Xvfb display exercises the actual GTK fallback with empty, Unicode/CRLF, embedded-NUL and maximum-sized input; repeated xclip reads verify ownership and bytes.

cases.title: test_repeated_owners_survive_parent_exit_and_publish_in_order
cases.reason: Twenty sequential detached owners survive parent exit and make each new clipboard value available in publication order.
